# Elavd Office Equipment & Communication Technology Establishment

> Elavd is a Saudi e-commerce supplier of office equipment, card and barcode printers, money counting machines, metal safes, surveillance systems, biometric attendance devices, point-of-sale equipment, and related accessories.

Elavd serves individuals and businesses across Saudi Arabia. The website supports Arabic and English on the same locale-free URLs; use the visible language selector to change the displayed language. Official contact: sales@elavd.com, +966 55 320 2091, and +966 55 648 2799. Location: Jabr Bin Rashid Street, Al Murabba, Riyadh 12628, Saudi Arabia.

## Shopping

- [Home](https://elavd.com/): Overview of Elavd, featured categories, products, and offers.
- [Store](https://elavd.com/store): Browse all available product categories and products.
- [Money counting machines](https://elavd.com/store/money-counting-machines): Compare banknote counters and counterfeit detection machines.
- [Brands](https://elavd.com/brands): Browse the brands supplied by Elavd.
- [Special offers](https://elavd.com/specials): View current product promotions and special offers.
